about: A house in the Kyiv suburbs, one team

A house in Koncha-Zaspa, Kozyn or Pushcha-Vodytsia usually starts with a plot among pines or near the water and ends with the interior, terraces and a garden. When the architect, builders, designer and landscaper work separately, the joints between them become the most expensive part of the project.

We run the whole house: design that fits the plot, construction, engineering, finishing, furnishing and landscape. Our projects include Hodos Villa (500 m²), Petrivtsi House (320 m²), Pidgirland (260 m², Kyiv region) and Smart Villa with a pool and lounge area.

On plots near water and forest, geology, groundwater level and foundation waterproofing matter most, so the design starts from the site data. The orientation of the house, the views, terraces and garden go into the site plan before the architecture.
Price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract; every 1–2 weeks we send photo reports, which is convenient if you live in the city or abroad.
How much a turnkey house costs
Construction from $600 per m², a turnkey house with finishing from $1,100 per m². For a 300 m² house the base calculation is 300 m² × $600 for the shell or 300 m² × $1,100 turnkey with finishing.

Renovation of an existing house from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), interior design from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500), landscape design from $50 per 100 m² (one sotka). The exact sum comes from the estimate after the survey.
